# SpanishBoom

> > SpanishBoom is a comprehensive Spanish learning platform featuring visual dictionaries, grammar lessons, phrasebooks, and immersive content through music, cartoons, and podcasts.

The site offers structured learning through a free Spanish course covering verb conjugations (Presente, Pretérito perfecto simple, Condicional simple) and practical phrasebooks, alongside engaging multimedia content including Peppa Pig episodes, Garfield comics, and Spanish music videos from artists like Nek and Ricky Martin. All lessons include native audio recordings and vocabulary support for learners at beginner to intermediate levels.

## Key Topics

- Spanish verb conjugation
- Visual vocabulary with audio
- Spanish phrasebook expressions
- Beginner Spanish lessons
- Peppa Pig Spanish transcriptions
- Spanish music lyrics translation
- Comic strip translations (Garfield, Dilbert)
- Presente tense
- Pretérito perfecto simple
- Condicional simple
- estar + gerundio construction
- Restaurant Spanish phrases
- Audio-based learning
- Spanish-English translation
- Immersive language learning

## Core Learning Resources

- [Free Spanish Course](https://spanishboom.com/free-spanish-course): Main Spanish course with lessons, dialogues, grammar, and native audio
- [Visual Spanish Dictionary](https://spanishboom.com/visual-spanish-dictionary): 1000-word visual Spanish dictionary with audio lessons

## Spanish Phrasebook

- [Spanish phrasebook: Introductions](https://spanishboom.com/spanish-phrasebook/introductions): Introduction phrases with audio covering greetings and formal/informal speech
- [Spanish phrasebook: At the restaurant](https://spanishboom.com/spanish-phrasebook/spanish-phrasebook-at-the-restaurant): Restaurant phrases and vocabulary with audio for ordering food
- [Spanish phrasebook: Colours and Shapes](https://spanishboom.com/spanish-phrasebook/spanish-phrasebook-colours-and-shapes): Colours and shapes vocabulary with audio for descriptive language

## Grammar & Verb Conjugation

- [Spanish Verbs. Lesson 5](https://spanishboom.com/free-spanish-course/spanish-verbs-lesson-5): Spanish course lesson 5: Future tense (Futuro simple) conjugation
- [Conditional: Condicional simple](https://spanishboom.com/spanish-grammar/condicional-simple): Condicional simple grammar guide with conjugation and usage examples
